cards.label: THERMAL INPUTS / MODEL
cards.title: Earth nominal · Target critical
cards.detail: Earth: nominal (33.9 K model margin). Target: critical (-9.3 K model margin). At least one input is outside the illustrative operating range; review that input and the thermal assumptions. Earth air and target surface inputs are different source domains; this is not measured rover hardware temperature.

cards.label: REGIONAL TILT / DEM MODEL
cards.title: Low regional tilt (1.4°)
cards.detail: Maximum absolute DEM/model pitch or roll; illustrative bands at 6° and 12°. Regional DEM/model tilt does not resolve wheel-scale obstacles, traction or centre-of-mass stability. This is not a local stability certification.
